description: Wastewater viral activity data from CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System via Socrata API

notes.early_signal: Viral RNA appears in wastewater 4-6 days before clinical cases increase
notes.limitation: Not all counties have wastewater sampling sites
notes.dataset_note: Consolidated onto the unified dataset atcp-73re (CDC Wastewater Viral Activity Level for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and RSV), which covers all three pathogens with a site-level viral activity metric (site_wval / site_wval_category). Replaces the prior per-disease datasets: covid metric dataset 2ew6-ywp6 plus the raw-sample datasets ymmh-divb (flu) and 45cq-cw4i (rsv), which used incompatible schemas. State field is the full state name (state_territory); counties are matched by name via counties_served (this dataset exposes no county FIPS).
